topics.hook_summary: The king of the four-year cycle zombies, Benjamin Cowen, was absolutely perplexed about how Bitcoin went above the May high. Dude, people are front running the October bottom because they realize the bottom is IN. You can't figure that out by looking at a chart. I felt illuminated when I came to the conclusion there's no such thing as a four-year cycle.
TAO going to 3000? Hell yeah, I totally agree. I think TAO can go a LOT more than that in the long run. We should be going into one hell of a fantastic economic expansion, very very soon.

We did the 58x on Velvet in June; I called it in July of last year, took 11 months. Called LAB in October, DCA'd more in December when it went down, then it does a 350x in May. Long term plays. Not these crazy things.

The point is: you got to get in, make money, and get out. Some pump to 3 million, some to 3 billion. If something dumps at 6 million like Golden Kitty, you can't say it's a scam: people got in, made money, got out. You do a 10x and you're happy; then it dumps and everybody else says it's a scam.
